fields.implementation_summary: Actions 1-7 remediation is largely implemented, including authoritative test-api validation, live ticket-state resolution, nested CLI commands, structured handoff evidence, and lock-before-finish checks. Independent review on 2026-07-14 found two remaining correctness blockers: age-only stale-lock reclamation can steal a live lock after 30 seconds and remove a successor lock, and ordinary idempotent init still rewrites a finished workspace. Action 8 remains blocked pending ownership-safe locking, finished-init immutability, deterministic race regressions, and reconciled durability claims.

fields.validation_summary: Previously reported focused suite: cargo test -p session-api -p session-cli -p session-mcp (121 passed). Restored runtime execution records resolve. This evidence is insufficient for closure because current tests do not exercise a live lock held past the stale threshold, a real finish/mutation interleaving, ordinary init after finish with byte-stability assertions, or platform-specific replacement failure behavior.

fields.implementation_summary: Remediation implementation is complete and ready for independent review. Runtime locking now uses the standard library's cross-platform OS-held exclusive file lock with a stable lock file: lock age never permits theft, process exit releases ownership, and guard drop does not unlink a successor's lock inode. Ordinary init after finish returns persisted state without rewriting context.json or active_workspace_session.json; new-run init and resume still reject. Deterministic finish-versus-mutation/init/resume coverage and Windows replacement-failure preservation coverage were added. The parent, runtime-context, and durable-workflow specs now limit durability claims to verified behavior; Unix parent-directory sync errors propagate and no unproven Windows replace-existing or power-loss guarantee remains. Action 8 remains blocked pending independent review.

fields.validation_summary: Authoritative evidence: exec-val-session-workflow-finish-remediation-20260714 under val-session-workflow-finish. Windows results: cargo test -p session-api passed 106 tests; cargo test -p session-api -p session-cli -p session-mcp passed 124 tests; cargo fmt --check -p session-api passed. Focused regressions passed for aged live lock exclusion/ownership-safe release, finished-init byte stability, deterministic finish exclusion of mutation/init/resume, and failed Windows replacement preserving previous bytes. Workspace-wide cargo fmt --check remains blocked by unrelated pre-existing formatting drift outside session-api.
